theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_atm_ball_le_transversal_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ν (ball x r) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * σ (ball (x - V.starProjection x) r)
